text:
maria: Quick idea — propose we add a 'graceful degradation matrix' for the router. It should map (customer_tier, region) -> ordered fallback variants + compatibility tags (tokenizer, ctx_len, tool_call). Need a schema before we wire routing logic.
jonathan: +1. One major failure mode we've seen: tokenizer differences cause token offsets to shift, which in turn shifts function-arg indices for tool-calls. That breaks downstream parsing.
kevin: Example we've hit: primary = rw-13b (bpe-A, 8k), fallback = rw-13b-q4 (bpe-B, 4k). Tool-call payloads get misaligned. Minimal example matrix entry below:
```
{
  "tier": "enterprise",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "primary": "rw-13b",
  "fallbacks": ["rw-13b-q4", "rw-13b-4k"],
  "compat": {"tokenizer": ["bpe-a","bpe-b"], "ctx_len": [8192,4096], "tool_call": [true,false]}
}
```
anya: Important: tool-calling parity is not fuzzy — either the model supports deterministic function-signature decoding or it doesn't. If not, we should transform the output or failover to a model that does.
jonathan: Console UX angle: we need a per-route 'degradation path' panel that lists the fallback order, compatibility badges (tokenizer matches, ctx >= required, toolcall supported), and telemetry links to sample diffs.
kevin: Telemetry to add: fallback_count, tokenizer_mismatch_count, toolcall_fallback_rate, avg_latency_by_variant. Recommend alert when toolcall_fallback_rate > 0.01 for paid tiers.
maria: For rollouts, the console should run preflight parity checks when you add a fallback: tokenizer hash compare, context-length test, and a tool-call decode sanity run with a small prompt set. Show pass/fail and example side-by-side diffs.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout job started for matrix-service v2 -> canary 5% :rocket:
jonathan: Canary note: make sure canary respects quota routing — public-tier fallback traffic must not be routed to enterprise-only variants.
anya: Edge case: regional quantized variant missing tokenizer artifacts in S3 -> runtime loads fallback generic tokenizer and tool-call parsing fails. Preflight must validate tokenizer artifact presence + hash.
kevin: Preflight script I prototyped:
```
./matrix-check --model rw-quant-13b-q4 --checks tokenizer,ctx,toolcall --samples samples/toolcall-smoke.json
```
maria: :thumbsup: I'll add this to the console workstream RFC. Owners: @jonathan telemetry, @kevin preflight scripts, @anya rollout policy. I'll update the RFC and link console mockups.
jonathan: SGTM. I'll wire dashboards: per-route waterfall showing variant hits, latency, and a small table of failing examples (with links to the eval blob).
kevin: We should also store a small 'diff' sample per preflight run so the console can show real diffs rather than synthetic heuristics.
maria: Thanks all — next steps: owners add short PRs (telemetry + preflight) and I'll follow up with a console mockup in #product in 48h.
